Metadata.title: Get iT — If you want it, you can get it
Metadata.description: The personal growth platform that turns your goals into plans, daily actions and measurable progress: physical, mental, social and financial.

Common.slogan: If you want it, you can get it.

physical.name: Physical
physical.description: Training, nutrition, sleep and energy. Build a body that keeps up with you.

mental.name: Mental
mental.description: Discipline, focus, confidence and stress management. Strengthen your mind.

social.name: Social
social.description: Communication, relationships, networking and leadership. Grow your circle.

financial.name: Financial
financial.description: Budgeting, saving, career and entrepreneurship. Take control of your money.

hero.title: If you want it, <accent>you can get it.</accent>
hero.subtitle: Get iT turns what you want into a concrete plan, daily actions and measurable progress. One platform to level up your whole life.

pillars.title: Four pillars. One life.
pillars.subtitle: Everything is connected: your body, your mind, your relationships and your finances. Get iT helps you grow in all of them at once.

how.title: Your progress, step by step
how.subtitle: The Get iT loop: decide, plan, act and progress. Then do it again, one level higher.

want.title: Choose what you want
want.description: A clear goal: gain 20 lb, save $10,000, launch your business or build confidence.

plan.title: Get your plan
plan.description: Get iT breaks your goal down into milestones, habits and concrete actions.

act.title: Take action
act.description: Every day, you know exactly what to do. Check it off, move forward.

progress.title: Level up
progress.description: XP, streaks and stats show your real progress, in every pillar of your life.

features.title: Everything you need to move forward
features.subtitle: One place for your goals, your plan, your tracking and your motivation.

today.title: Today
today.description: Your daily plan at a glance: habits, tasks and priorities.

ai.title: Get iT AI
ai.description: A coach that knows your goals and your progress. It helps you choose your next action and adjusts your plan.

progress.title: Progress
progress.description: Earn XP, level up and keep your streaks, all based on your real actions.

community.title: Get iT Center
community.description: A community that wants to grow, just like you. Share your wins, inspire and get inspired.

cta.title: Your best self starts today.
